parts.tooltip: pair :: F x ⟶ F y ⟶ F (x, y) — the Applicative-specific part (the monoidal structure of F). Combines both contexts: Maybe needs both Just, List takes all combinations, Validation accumulates both errors, IO runs both effects in order.
fmap apply :: F ((a ⟶ b), a) ⟶ F b — from Functor. apply (f, a) = f a, mapped under the combined context.
